visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with auburn hair wearing a black and white Adidas t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She excitedly presents a large white box with 'GO Goal' branding, opening it to reveal products inside while smiling broadly. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor garden with a pond. The woman, now in a beige sports bra, eats a chocolate protein bar. Digital heart icons appear around her head as she chews and shows the interior of the bar to the camera. (3) Close-up shots feature white snack bags labeled 'Protein Chips' in various flavors. The woman pours the orange-colored rectangular chips into a small white bowl and eats one, pointing upward to indicate satisfaction. (4) A product shot displays a can of 'Body Goals' chocolate protein drink. The woman opens the can and drinks it while standing in the park, later holding the can up for a close-up. (5) The woman wears a white baseball cap and black leggings, standing with a silver bicycle. She holds up a white 'GO Goal' branded towel before the video cuts to a POV shot of her cycling up a paved hill in a sunny residential area. (6) The woman sits cross-legged on a stone ledge in the park with all the products (box, chips, bar, drink) displayed before her. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands to emphasize the promotional details.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with red-tinted hair, initially in an Adidas shirt, then wearing a beige sports bra and black leggings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor hallway with a photo wall, followed by an outdoor landscaped park with a pond, green trees, and an urban residential street with buildings.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice gasps 'Wa!' in excitement, immediately followed by the onset of an upbeat, fast-paced electronic pop BGM with a bright synth lead and rhythmic percussion. (2) A male narrator begins speaking in a clear, highly enthusiastic broadcasting tone, describing the protein bars. A crisp 'crunch' SFX is heard as the woman bites the bar, followed by a 'whoosh' transition sound. (3) The narrator continues with high verbal density as the sound of a plastic bag rustling and chips hitting a ceramic bowl is audible. A playful 'ding' SFX highlights specific product features. (4) A distinctive metallic 'click' and a soft 'tshh' sound indicate a can tab being pulled. The BGM remains energetic in the background. (5) Light outdoor ambience including faint wind and bicycle chain clicks is heard during the cycling sequence, with the male narration transitioning into a call to action. (6) The music maintains its tempo as the narrator details the 'Double 11' prizes (iPhone, Japan trip), using energetic pitch inflections. The audio ends with a bright final musical flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Unboxing -> Product Features (Bar, Chips, Drink) -> Brand Activity -> CTA/Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional advertisement for 'Body Goals' fitness snacks and beverages. It uses an unboxing hook to build curiosity, followed by a detailed showcase of nutritional benefits (high protein, low calorie) and taste appeal, concluding with an enticing 'Double 11' shopping festival promotion and giveaway to drive sales and brand engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator unboxes a gift set, explicitly reviews multiple products from the brand, includes a discount code, and details a brand-sponsored giveaway.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully combines 'unboxing' and 'vlog' elements with high-speed editing and technical narration to maintain viewer interest. The use of a discount code [petersusan] suggests an affiliate partnership.
